test_case.test_name: Parameterized all-peer TransferBench bidirectional saturation sweep from 1K through 1G
test_case.purpose: Measure the bidirectional saturation curve for every approved device peer at every power-of-two payload from 1K to 1G and compare each pair/size result with its approved minimum.
required_package: Pinned TransferBench binary/source revision, checksum and ROCm/driver compatibility
Stable GPU UUID/BDF, CPU NUMA and complete applicable peer map
Exact power-of-two payload list 1K,2K,...,1G plus warmup/repetition/aggregation policy
Approved per-pair/per-size bandwidth thresholds and output-table schema
Sustained-load window, per-step timeout, cooling/power aborts and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: After artifact, topology, threshold and load approval, run `USE_GPU_DMA=1 ./TransferBench p2p <size>` independently for every power-of-two size from 1K through 1G, retaining full outputs labeled by stable peer and size. Enforce the approved timeout/abort policy at each step; do not skip later or earlier sizes or replace the curve with one aggregate score.
test_case.expected_result: Every required peer/size cell is present and meets its approved threshold/aggregation rule, the curve contains no unexplained discontinuity, and topology plus GPU/PCIe/xGMI/thermal/power/platform health remain stable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete peer-by-size coverage and every approved threshold. Missing cells, a single aggregate score, or absent approved limits cannot pass.
safety_gate: Sustained multi-peer load requires explicit approval, cooling/power headroom and workload isolation.
Pin GPUs by UUID/BDF and CPUs by NUMA; do not infer numeric indices.
Apply a bounded timeout to each payload and stop the sweep on a hang or health fault.
Abort on topology drift, XID/ECC/PCIe/xGMI error, thermal/power limit or kernel/BMC fault; no automatic retry or blind continuation.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate thermal-stimulus identity
TransferBench/ROCm/driver checksums and complete peer map
Exact ordered 1K..1G invocation log and full raw outputs
Per-pair/per-size parsed matrix with approved thresholds/aggregation
Thermal/power/GPU/link/kernel/BMC health traces and final idle cleanup
test_case.recovery: Stop tracked benchmark processes at the first timeout/fault, preserve the partial matrix and health logs, verify all devices return idle and links remain healthy, and escalate. Do not continue at the next size or rerun automatically.
